author: GitHub
description:
Hackathons are much more than continuous coding and zero sleep; they are invention marathons where developers, students, and beginners build real projects. In this short documentary, participants and organizers share how hackathons foster lifelong friendships, teach failure-driven learning, and lower the bar to building software. Watch to see how trial, error, free pizza, and tools like GitHub Copilot help turn raw ideas into working applications.

#Hackathon #GitHub #GitHubCopilot
